capabilities.name: Shipment Tracking Portal
capabilities.description: Provides logged-in customers with a modern, mobile-responsive interface to view their active shipments and current locations.

capabilities.name: Invoice Management Portal
capabilities.description: Enables customers to view and download their invoices directly from the portal, reducing manual queries for the operations team.

capabilities.validation_reason: Depends on confirmation of TMS API details (ASM_02) and IT Manager availability (DEP_01).
capabilities.name: TMS Tracking Integration
capabilities.description: Integrates the portal with the existing Transportation Management System (TMS) to retrieve real-time shipment tracking details.

capabilities.validation_reason: Depends on confirmation of Finance System API details (ASM_02) and IT Manager availability (DEP_01).
capabilities.name: Finance System Invoice Integration
capabilities.description: Integrates the portal with the finance system to retrieve invoice documents for customer access.

capabilities.validation_reason: Depends on selection of payment gateway (ASM_03).
capabilities.name: Online Invoice Payment
capabilities.description: Provides customers with the option to pay their invoices online through a secure payment gateway integrated with the portal.

capabilities.name: Online Shipment Query Submission
capabilities.description: Allows customers to submit support queries regarding specific shipments directly within the portal, reducing operational workload.

capabilities.name: Online Collection Booking
capabilities.description: Enables customers to book cargo collections online through the portal.

capabilities.name: Monthly Volume Reporting
capabilities.description: Provides customers with monthly summaries of their shipment volumes.

capabilities.validation_reason: Depends on confirmation of user/shipment volumes (ASM_01), target cloud platform (ASM_04), and security standards (ASM_05).
capabilities.name: Portal Infrastructure & Security
capabilities.description: Establishes the underlying cloud infrastructure, deployment, and standard security measures for the customer portal.

modules.name: Customer Self-Service Portal
modules.description: Groups all customer-facing functionalities for self-service and interaction.

modules.name: Core Integrations
modules.description: Manages all integrations with external and internal systems to power portal data.

modules.name: Platform & Infrastructure
modules.description: Covers the foundational technical components, hosting, and security aspects of the portal.

out_of_scope.text: Migration or modernization of existing TMS or Finance systems.
out_of_scope.reason: The project scope is limited to the new customer portal and its integrations, not the underlying legacy systems.

out_of_scope.text: Ad-hoc or highly customizable reporting capabilities beyond monthly volume summaries.
out_of_scope.reason: FR_06 specifies 'monthly summaries' of shipment volumes, not a full business intelligence reporting suite.

out_of_scope.text: Multi-language support for the portal interface.
out_of_scope.reason: No customer requirement was stated for multi-language support.

recommended_enhancements.validation_reason: This is a recommendation beyond the stated scope and requires customer validation.
recommended_enhancements.description: Implement proactive notifications for shipment status updates via email or SMS.
recommended_enhancements.rationale: This builds on the shipment tracking capability (FR_01) and further reduces the operations team's workload (BR_02) by automatically informing customers of key events, minimizing inbound inquiries.

recommended_enhancements.validation_reason: This is a recommendation beyond the stated scope and requires customer validation.
recommended_enhancements.description: Introduce user role management within the portal to allow different levels of access or features for various customer types or internal users.
recommended_enhancements.rationale: While PER_02 broadly defines 'Customers', different client needs or internal roles (PER_01) could benefit from tailored access, enhancing security and personalization.

recommended_enhancements.validation_reason: This is a recommendation beyond the stated scope and requires customer validation.
recommended_enhancements.description: Integrate a customer feedback mechanism (e.g., surveys, rating system) directly into the portal.
recommended_enhancements.rationale: This directly supports the 'Customer Portal Initiative' (BR_01) by providing continuous insights into customer satisfaction and areas for improvement, fostering a data-driven approach to UX enhancements.

recommended_enhancements.validation_reason: This is a recommendation beyond the stated scope and requires customer validation.
recommended_enhancements.description: Develop an AI-powered chatbot to handle common customer inquiries and provide instant answers.
recommended_enhancements.rationale: This directly addresses the goal to 'Reduce Operations Workload' (BR_02) and complements 'Online Shipment Queries' (FR_04) by automating responses to frequently asked questions, further freeing up the operations team.
